# IndoGig

> IndoGig is a hospitality workforce planning product for Bali venues, operated by PT INDOGIG HRTECH INDONESIA in Seminyak, Bali.

The proposed founding pilot covers one venue for 30 days. The workflow starts with regular staff and the venue's own flexible workers, then tracks confirmed coverage, attendance and approved hours. WhatsApp is used for communication and links. Managers use the web workspace for scheduling and review.

External sourcing is a separate enquiry subject to confirmed availability and terms. The employer pays workers directly. IndoGig quotes its services separately. Approved hours are prepared for the employer's existing finance process.
